`doodle`
========

Plays random doodles.

Usage
-----

```
doodle.exe [OPTIONS]
```

### Options ###

#### `-n`, `--iter <ITER>` ####

Number of iterations to run.

If absent, the program will run indefinitely until interrupted.

#### `-h`, `--help` ####

Print help (see a summary with `-h`)

#### `-V`, `--version` ####

Print version
